current.text: He is projected to come off the bench as the likely sixth man. The projected starters are Brunson, Bridges, Hart, Anunoby and Towns.
Leaving him outside the top 200 is fine. Look at him only if someone in the Knicks rotation gets hurt.
He did not agree to a contract extension. The front office has said it will not negotiate contract extensions.
He is a possible trade candidate.
The Knicks play a league-minimum 13 back-to-backs. Their fantasy playoff schedule is weak for a season that ends March 28.
The Knicks are projected to win about 50 to 54 games.

durable.text: When he started, he scored but gave weak defensive stats.
He has dealt with abdominal issues.

note: With a Yahoo rank of 197, an ESPN rank of 236 and a 0 USD value on both sites, he falls well outside the 144 players we draft, so do not bid on him. He makes about 2.2 threes per game with few turnovers. But his FG%, rebounds and blocks are low, and that only works as a bench sixth man. Watch him on waivers early in the season in case a Knicks guard or wing gets hurt or a trade opens a starting role, and remember the weak schedule in our March 28 playoff weeks.
